greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi kunye nani nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, siye saphulukana nendlela yokubona uthando lwakho, sibe nenceba.
Kristu, usixolele ngenxa yokuba asizange siqonde ixesha lokundwendwela kwakho, sibe nenceba.
Nkosi, usinike uxolo oluvela kuwe, sibe nenceba.
psalm_response: IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli ukuba sikhonze uThixo wethu.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umfana ehlala phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, iminwe yakhe ibaleka kwiikhibhodi ngokukhawuleza, ebhala iikhowudi ze-'con chim airlines' yakhe. UBenjamin Vo wayengengomfana nje owayethanda iinqwelo-moya; wayengumfana owayethanda ukwakha, owayethanda ukudibanisa izinto, owayefuna ukuba ihlabathi libe yindawo efikelelekayo. Wayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu koko, wayenentliziyo eyayihlala ivulekile. Khumbula indlela awayemomotheka ngayo xa wayethetha ngale nkampani yakhe ye-'con chim airlines'. Yayiyiphupha elincinci, kodwa yayithwele ukukhanya kweminyaka yakhe elishumi elinesihlanu. 

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane ubona into enzulu kakhulu. Ubona iscroll esivalwe ngezitywina ezisixhenxe. 'Ndiye ndabona umnyango ovulekileyo ezulwini,' utsho, kodwa apha ubona iscroll esingekho mntu unokuvula. UYohane uyakhala. Uva intlungu yokungakwazi ukubona oko kusezandleni zikaThixo. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYohane uyakhala. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa ubona ubomi buhamba ngendlela ongaqondiyo, xa ubona iscroll sobomi bukaBen sivalwa ngaphambi kokuba sibe nexesha elaneleyo, uva intlungu efana neyikaYohane. Kodwa ke, uva amazwi athuthuzelayo: 'Musa ukukhala. IMvana yezizwe zakwaYuda, ingcambu kaDavide, iye yaphumelela.' 

IMvana. Le Mvana ifana neyona nto inamandla kwindalo iphela, kodwa ikwabonakala 'ngathi ixheliwe'. Oku kukujika kokholo. UYesu, owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngokunikela, ubonakala esixelela ukuba emva kwentlungu, emva kokufa, kukho uvuko. UBen, ngoku, akasekho kweli hlabathi lethu elincinci, kodwa ukwiBanquet yaseZulwini. Ukhona apho iinqwelo-moya zakhe, i-'con chim airlines' yakhe, zibhabha phambi kobuso bukaThixo ngoxolo olungapheliyo. 

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uyalila. 'As Jesus drew near Jerusalem, he saw the city and wept over it.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu uyalila. UYesu akalili ngenxa yokuba engumntu ongenamandla, kodwa ulila ngenxa yokuba uyabona ukuba abantu abaqondi ukuba 'yintoni eyenza uxolo'. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Mamele kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Nikhumbula xa uBen wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam? Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku. UBen wayengumntwana wokukhanya. Wayengumfana owayethanda iinqwelo-moya, owayethanda ukuhamba nehlabathi, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Xa uBen wayephila, wayephila ngokukhanya. Kwaye nangoku, nangona engasekho emzimbeni, ukukhanya kwakhe kusaqhubeka.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci, xa wayesadlala neebhaluni zakhe phambi kwe-fireplace.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwena ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ngoku ndingenakukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze ngomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi ubusendaweni yam, kwaye ndizimanyanise nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo angahlala enani, aninike uxolo nentuthuzelo kwimihla yenu yonke. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike ithemba, kwaye abomeleze entliziyweni.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona umqulu esandleni sokunene salowo uhleli etroneni. Wawunemibhalo macala omabini, utywinwe ngezitywina ezisixhenxe. Ndabona ingelosi enamandla imemezela ngezwi elikhulu, 'Ngubani ofanelekileyo ukuwuvula umqulu, aqhawule nezitywina zawo?' Kodwa akukho mntu ezulwini, nasemhlabeni, nasezantsi komhlaba owawunako ukuwuvula umqulu okanye ukuwuhlola. Ndakhala iinyembezi ezininzi kuba akukho mntu wafunyanwa efanelekileyo ukuwuvula umqulu okanye ukuwuhlola. Omnye wabadala wathi kum, 'Musa ukukhala. Ingonyama yesizwe sakwaYuda, ingcambu kaDavide, iye yaphumelela, imenza akwazi ukuwuvula umqulu ngezitywina zawo ezisixhenxe.' Ndabona ke phakathi etroneni nakwizidalwa ezine eziphilayo nakubadala, iMvana ebonakala ngathi ixheliwe. Yayineempondo ezisixhenxe namehlo asixhenxe; leyo yimimoya esixhenxe kaThixo ethunyelwe ehlabathini lonke. Yeza yamkela umqulu esandleni sokunene salowo uhleli etroneni. Akawuthatha, izidalwa ezine eziphilayo nabadala abamashumi amabini anesine bawa phambi kweMvana. Ngamnye wabadala wayephethe uhadi neebhola zegolide ezigcwele impepho, leyo yimithandazo yabangcwele. Bacula ingoma entsha: 'Ufanelekile wena ukwamkela umqulu nokuqhawula izitywina zawo, kuba uxhaliwe, kwaye ngeGazi lakho uthenge abantu kuThixo abavela kuzo zonke izizwe neelwimi, abantu kunye nohlanga. Ubenze ubukumkani bababingeleli kuThixo wethu, kwaye baya kulawula emhlabeni.'

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli ukuba sikhonze uThixo wethu. Culanini eNkosini ingoma entsha, yodumo kwibandla labathembekileyo. Mayivuye uSirayeli kuMenzi wakhe, abantwana baseZiyon mabavuye eKumkanini wabo. R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli ukuba sikhonze uThixo wethu. Mabadumise igama lakhe ngomdaniso womthendeleko, mabadumise kuye ngohadi nangezixhobo zomculo. Kuba iNkosi iyabathanda abantu bayo, kwaye ihombisa abathobekileyo ngoloyiso. R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli ukuba sikhonze uThixo wethu. Abathembekileyo mabavuya eluzukweni; mabacule ngovuyo ezililini zabo; Mabadumise uThixo ngezwi elikhulu. Oku kuluzuko lwabo bonke abathembekileyo bakhe. Alleluia. R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli ukuba sikhonze uThixo wethu.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Akusondela uYesu eJerusalem, wawubona umzi, wawulilela, esithi, 'Ukuba ubukwazi nani ngolu suku oko kuzisa uxolo–kodwa ngoku kufihlakele emehlweni enu. Kuba iintsuku ziyeza phezu kwenu apho iintshaba zenu ziya kwakha udonga olujikeleze nina; ziya kunijikeleza zininqande macala onke. Ziya kunityumza emhlabeni kunye nabantwana benu abaphakathi kwenu, kwaye aziyi kushiya litye phezu kwelinye ngenxa yokuba ningazange naliqonda ixesha lokundwendwela kwam.'

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
